verdict.root_cause: The agent clicked the menu while the cookie notice was still visible, then repeated consent and menu actions instead of confirming that the notice had closed and continuing through the required navigation.
verdict.agent_fault_assessment: The agent's sequence caused the outcome: it attempted the menu at step 0-3 before the consent overlay had been cleared, retried cookie consent and then attempted the menu again at step 0-7. It never completed the required hover over “О ГОЗНАКЕ” or selected “Компания сегодня”. The available evidence does not prove that the site itself ignored a correctly completed consent action, so this should not be treated as a confirmed product defect.
